title: The countdown to GPT-5

market.contractText: What day will GPT-5 be released?

events.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-4.5 as a research preview
events.plausibleImpact: A large interim GPT release could make an imminent GPT-5 launch less likely while clarifying the product ladder.

events.headline: OpenAI launches the GPT-4.1 family in its API
events.plausibleImpact: A new named family and the announced GPT-4.5 deprecation created information about sequencing and successor timing.

events.headline: OpenAI releases o3 and o4-mini and previews o3-pro
events.plausibleImpact: Another frontier-model launch could delay GPT-5, while the promise of a near-term o3-pro release could signal a staged rollout before the next GPT generation.

events.headline: OpenAI makes o3-pro available to Pro users and developers
events.plausibleImpact: A major reasoning-model release just weeks before the market's target window could push expectations for GPT-5 later.

events.headline: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT agent, combining research and browser action
events.plausibleImpact: A substantial product launch creates both a possible pre-GPT-5 distraction and evidence that OpenAI was shipping the capabilities expected around a new flagship release.

ending.text: OpenAI announced GPT-5 and made it available to the public; the selected date outcome was August 7. Keep the release announcement separate from the five cards.
